title: Kelly C NDEs 6611 NDE 6611
content: The first experience was in 1995. I had an allergic reaction to Sulfa. After taking it, I went to the bathroom. I fell over while sitting on the toilet. I screamed, ‘Someone help me, I can't get up!’ My mom came running and my nephew got me up from the toilet and I remember walking out to the living room, really out of it. I heard, ‘Lay her down here.’ My nephew said, ‘Should we call 911?’ My dad said, ‘No, just wait, she will be okay.’ All I remember is a paramedic saying, ‘Kelly, stay with us!’ over and over again. Then I saw this tunnel with a bright light and I walked through it and on the other side, I saw my late grandmother and God, all in white, glowing. My grandmother turned to God and said, ‘She isn't ready to come in here.’ God said something, and I woke up in the emergency room. I turned to my dad, who was sitting beside my mom on my right, and I said to him, ‘Dad, Grandma says she is okay, and to stop worrying about her, she is fine.’ Dad was in tears. I went home the same day, which baffled doctors and nurses. I said, ‘I'm fine!’ and I left the emergency room. I said, ‘I'm hungry,’ so we went to McDonald's and I got a double cheeseburger, fries, and a milkshake. I was fine after that. When I got home, I asked, ‘What happened to me?’ My mom said, ‘You were dead for forty-five minutes and that nurse was yelling at me about you.’ They had to use the paddles on me, but nothing worked; that's what my Mom said. I don't remember anything after the paramedic was saying, ‘Kelly, stay with us.’ The second experience was in 1998. I took the Sulfa drug, but I don't remember where that was. I also had a very high fever. I remember going to the emergency room in the car. Next, I saw the tunnel that turned into a bright light and I walked through it. I saw my mom's best friend's late son and he turned to me and said, ‘Tell my mom, I'm fine and stop worrying about us.’ I woke up in the emergency room, turned, told Marge that Mike is fine, and to stop worrying about them. Marge was in tears. My mom said I was dead almost thirty-eight minutes. The third experience was in 1999. I took Biaxan (drug) in Los Angeles. All I remember is the tunnel, bright light, and God all in white and my best friend who passed away in 1987. She said, ‘I'm fine.’ and I woke up. She had died from a drive-by shooting that happened in Long Beach. She was holding her then thirteen-month old daughter, who died eighteen years later from a drug overdose.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Allergic reactions/medication reactions: Sulfa (1995, 1998) and Biaxan (1999); 1998 also included a very high fever.

stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Each experience: tunnel/bright light, then encounter with deceased person(s) and/or God, then return to the emergency room after being told/indicated she was not ready.
stage_sequence.repeated_stage_detail: Tunnel/bright light and return occurred across all three experiences.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Multiple NDEs associated with medication reactions; repeated messages to deliver to living relatives/friends that the deceased are fine.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “She isn't ready to come in here.” “Kelly, stay with us!” “Tell my mom, I'm fine and stop worrying about us.” “Dad, Grandma says she is okay, and to stop worrying about her, she is fine.”
